# googleappsscript_deployment (Resource)

A deployment of a project version, e.g. as web app, API executable, add-on or library.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "googleappsscript_deployment" "example" {
  script_id      = googleappsscript_project.example.id
  version_number = googleappsscript_version.example.version_number
  description    = "Production"
}

output "url" {
  value = googleappsscript_deployment.example.web_app_url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `script_id` (String) Script ID of the project.
- `version_number` (Number) Version to deploy.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Deployment description.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Deployment ID.
- `web_app_url` (String) Web app URL, if the manifest configures a web app.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import googleappsscript_deployment.example {script_id}/{deployment_id}
```
